note: One keymap for both surfaces. Help, the shortcut sheet, menus, tooltips and aria-keyshortcuts all read this file. Per-viewer overrides are stored as a diff against it. Keys only navigate or arm; no key posts or admits work.

scopes.global: Always active; always uses a modifier (WCAG 2.1.4).
scopes.region: Active while focus is anywhere in one region (navigator, center, evidence, work view, dock).
scopes.composite: Active while focus is inside a list, grid, tree or listbox.
scopes.code: Active while focus is inside a code well (Listing, Decompile, Hex, diffs).
scopes.edit: Active in edit mode inside an editable well or inline editor; other single keys are off.

escapeOrder: close the open peek or menu
leave edit mode, restoring the text
close the dialog, returning focus to its invoker
clear a transient filter typed in this view
nothing else — Esc never clears the checked set or held panes

profiles.default: Modifier globals plus focus-scoped single keys below.
profiles.ida: Adds focus-scoped n (rename), y (set type), ; (comment), g (go to address) in code wells.
profiles.off: Turns every single-character key off; modifier globals and menus remain.

commands.label: Go
commands.note: Moves the primary location and pushes one history stop.

commands.label: Open beside
commands.note: Opens a secondary pane; the primary selection does not change.

commands.label: Peek
commands.note: Also after a 400ms pointer rest or 800ms focus rest. Alt+Enter and Ctrl/Cmd+I are rejected.

commands.label: Keep
commands.where: inside a Peek or evidence card
commands.note: The Keep button (aria-pressed) is the primary control. The letter works only while focus is inside a Peek or on a kept card, never on list rows (where k moves); from a trigger, Tab then K, or the link menu. Carried as keep=…

commands.label: Open in new browser tab
commands.note: Native browser behavior.

commands.label: Go to anything
commands.note: Prefixes @ symbol, : address, # logical id, ! job, % receipt, ~ node, > command, $ string, ' marks, ? help.

commands.label: Back
commands.note: Always acts on the primary history. Not intercepted in text fields or edit mode. Mouse buttons 4/5 and the browser buttons work natively through popstate. Held panes' own Back/Forward buttons never touch browser history.

commands.label: Forward
commands.note: Always acts on the primary history. Not intercepted in text fields or edit mode. Mouse buttons 4/5 and the browser buttons work natively through popstate. Held panes' own Back/Forward buttons never touch browser history.

commands.label: Recent locations
keys: Enter on the Recent menu button
commands.note: APG Menu Button beside Back: up to 20 of this tab's stops with label, time and ✎ edited. Back itself has no history menu, no Alt+↓ and no long-press.

commands.label: Next region
commands.note: Restores the region's last focus. Where the browser takes F6, use g then the region letter.

commands.label: Show or hide evidence rail
commands.note: Ctrl+Alt+B types a character on some AltGr layouts; there the editor shows the altGrCaution warning and the command stays reachable through the palette, the View menu and g then e (focus the rail, which opens it).

commands.label: Show or hide dock
commands.note: Opening focuses the row of the last announced transition; again returns.

commands.label: Layout preset 1–5
commands.note: Read, Compare, Review, Triage, Verify rebuild; also in the View menu, the palette and the NavigationBar layout menu. Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+digit was rejected because it types characters on AltGr keyboards. A switch pushes history only when it changes the workspace.

commands.label: Move selection
commands.note: Following panes update after the settle delay.

commands.label: Repeat armed action on focused row
commands.note: Arms the ActionStrip; mutations still confirm.

commands.label: Set mark
commands.note: Lowercase a–z per viewer; named marks through the palette ('Set mark…'). Marks resolve per build through the locator.

commands.label: Arm Decide for the checked set
Focus reflected row in the other view
Find in this well
commands.note: Announces '3 of 12 matches'; browser find elsewhere.

commands.label: Rename (IDA profile)
commands.note: profile ida

commands.label: Set type (IDA profile)
commands.note: profile ida

commands.label: Comment (IDA profile)
commands.note: profile ida

commands.label: Leader for region and view jumps
commands.note: Shows which-key hints. Regions: g n navigator, g m main, g e evidence, g w work view, g j dock. Views: g l listing, g d decompile, g h hex, g r graph. Panels: g o outline, g x references, g c counterparts, g ' marks. Layouts: g 1…5.

commands.label: Function outline
commands.note: Blocks, locals, calls and strings of the current function; the same content as the rail's Outline section.

conflictPolicy: Two commands bound to the same key in the same scope do nothing until the conflict is resolved; the status line says which binding is blocked and why.
altGrCaution: Ctrl+Alt combinations type characters on AltGr keyboards. The editor warns when a binding (default or remap) uses one on the active layout, and every such command stays reachable from the palette and the View menu.
